blocks.zh: Section 2: Calibration, Testing Procedures & Results | 校正、試驗程序與結果
blocks.en: Section 2: Calibration, Testing Procedures & Results

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握凍結點法（Method 1）與蒸氣壓法（Method 2）的完整操作程序與日常校正確認流程
blocks.en: Master the complete operating procedures of the freezing-point method (Method 1) and the vapor pressure method (Method 2), and the daily calibration check routine

blocks.zh: 了解樣品前處理原則：固體注射劑重配、不可任意乘以稀釋因子的規定及其科學依據
blocks.en: Understand the principles of sample preparation: reconstitution of solid injections, and the rule that results must not be multiplied by a dilution factor, together with the scientific basis for it

blocks.zh: 正確表達 osmolality 結果的單位與報告格式（mOsmol/kg，取至整數）
blocks.en: Express osmolality results correctly in terms of units and reporting format (mOsmol/kg, rounded to a whole number)

blocks.zh: 從 osmolality（測量值）換算 osmolarity（計算值）：掌握公式 ξ<sub>c</sub> = ξ<sub>m</sub> × (ρ − C) 及實際計算
blocks.en: Convert osmolality (measured value) to osmolarity (calculated value): master the formula ξ<sub>c</sub> = ξ<sub>m</sub> × (ρ − C) and its practical calculation

blocks.zh: 理解 tonicity（張力）的臨床定義及其與 osmolality/osmolarity 的關係與差異
blocks.en: Understand the clinical definition of tonicity and its relationship to, and differences from, osmolality/osmolarity

blocks.zh: 了解「已刪除」的舊版 Osmolarity 與 Measurement of Osmolality 章節的歷史沿革及現行版本的整合
blocks.en: Understand the history of the "deleted" former Osmolarity and Measurement of Osmolality sections and how they are integrated in the current version

blocks.zh: Operation and Calibration — Standard Solutions 標準液配製與校正
blocks.en: Operation and Calibration — Standard Solutions

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 校正 vs. 校正確認（Calibration vs. Calibration Check）的重要區別：
blocks.en: The important difference between Calibration and Calibration Check:

blocks.zh: Calibration（完整校正）：至少兩點（低 + 高標準液），調整儀器讀數使其符合標準值。通常在開始使用新標準液時或 PQ 定期重新校正時執行。
blocks.en: Calibration (full calibration): at least two points (a low and a high standard), adjusting the instrument reading to match the standard value. Usually performed when starting to use a new standard solution or at PQ periodic recalibration.

blocks.zh: Calibration Check（校正確認）：每日使用前的快速確認，不調整儀器，只判斷「當前是否仍在接受標準內」。若不通過，才執行完整校正再確認。
blocks.en: Calibration Check: a quick check before each day of use that does not adjust the instrument and only determines whether it is "still within the acceptance criteria at present". Only if it fails is a full calibration performed, followed by a further check.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 校正確認標準液選擇邏輯：
blocks.en: Logic for selecting the calibration check standard:

blocks.zh: 首選：在預期測量範圍中心點的標準液（最佳代表性）
blocks.en: First choice: the standard at the center of the expected measurement range (best representativeness)

blocks.zh: 備選：兩個「夾住」測量值且各自在 ±300 mOsmol/kg 內的標準液
blocks.en: Alternative: two standards that "bracket" the measured value and are each within ±300 mOsmol/kg of it

blocks.zh: 目的：確保校正在最相關的濃度範圍內是準確的，而非只驗證了遠離實際使用點的範圍
blocks.en: Purpose: to ensure the calibration is accurate in the most relevant concentration range, rather than only verifying a range far from the actual point of use

blocks.zh: 標準液冷凍禁止：冷凍會破壞溶液均勻性（部分水先結冰，改變剩餘液體濃度），解凍後即使外觀正常，滲透量也可能偏移。
blocks.en: Do not freeze standard solutions: freezing destroys the homogeneity of the solution (part of the water freezes first and changes the concentration of the remaining liquid), so even if the solution looks normal after thawing, its osmolality may have shifted.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 校正確認就像每天早上上磅秤前先用已知重量的砝碼確認一下——你不是重新校準磅秤，而是確認它今天仍然準確。若砝碼顯示偏差，才需要重新校準。這樣的日常確認既省時間，又保證了每次測量都有當日的品質保證。
blocks.en: A calibration check is like using a known weight to check the scale each morning before you step on it: you are not recalibrating the scale, only confirming that it is still accurate today. Only if the weight shows a deviation do you need to recalibrate. This kind of daily check saves time and also gives every measurement that day's quality assurance.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 批次放行 SOP 中，校正確認結果應記入批次記錄（Batch Record）或儀器使用記錄。若校正確認失敗，需：(1) 執行完整校正；(2) 重新確認；(3) 評估失敗期間已測的樣品是否需要重新測試；(4) 記錄偏差報告（Deviation Report）。步驟 (3) 是最容易被忽略的，但也是最重要的患者安全保障措施。
blocks.en: In a CDMO batch release SOP, the calibration check result should be recorded in the batch record or the instrument use log. If the calibration check fails, you need to: (1) perform a full calibration; (2) re-check; (3) assess whether samples measured during the failure period need to be retested; (4) record a deviation report. Step (3) is the one most easily overlooked, but it is also the most important patient safety safeguard.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若產品滲透量規格為 270–320 mOsmol/kg，你應選擇哪個 Table 1 標準液作為每日校正確認液？請說明選擇邏輯。
blocks.en: If the product osmolality specification is 270–320 mOsmol/kg, which Table 1 standard should you choose as the daily calibration check solution? Explain the selection logic.

blocks.zh: 「校正確認」與「完整校正」各應在什麼時機執行？能否用校正確認取代完整校正？
blocks.en: When should a "calibration check" and a "full calibration" each be performed? Can a calibration check replace a full calibration?

blocks.zh: 若今日校正確認顯示 290 mOsmol/kg 標準液讀得 295 mOsmol/kg，是否需要重新校正？（提示：接受標準為 ±4 mOsmol/kg）
blocks.en: If today's calibration check reads 295 mOsmol/kg for the 290 mOsmol/kg standard, does the instrument need to be recalibrated? (Hint: the acceptance criterion is ±4 mOsmol/kg)

blocks.zh: Test Solutions & Method 1: Freezing-Point Osmometry 樣品處理與凍結點法程序
blocks.en: Test Solutions & Method 1: Freezing-Point Osmometry

blocks.zh: 稀釋後不可乘以稀釋因子——這是最重要的操作限制！
blocks.en: Do not multiply by a dilution factor after dilution. This is the most important operating restriction!

blocks.zh: 原因在於 osmolality coefficient（Φ<sub>m</sub>）是濃度的非線性函數。假設你將 600 mOsmol/kg 的樣品稀釋一半，若 osmolality 也正好是原來的一半（300 mOsmol/kg），這只是巧合，不是規律。實際上：
blocks.en: The reason is that the osmolality coefficient (Φ<sub>m</sub>) is a nonlinear function of concentration. Suppose you dilute a 600 mOsmol/kg sample by half; if the osmolality also happens to be exactly half of the original (300 mOsmol/kg), that is only a coincidence, not a rule. In reality:

blocks.zh: 在低濃度下，電解質解離程度改變
blocks.en: At low concentrations, the degree of electrolyte dissociation changes

blocks.zh: 溶質-溶劑相互作用改變
blocks.en: Solute-solvent interactions change

blocks.zh: Φ<sub>m</sub> 本身也隨濃度改變
blocks.en: Φ<sub>m</sub> itself also changes with concentration

blocks.zh: 因此稀釋後的讀數只代表稀釋後溶液的滲透量，不能外推回原始濃度。
blocks.en: The reading after dilution therefore represents only the osmolality of the diluted solution and cannot be extrapolated back to the original concentration.

blocks.zh: Method 1 操作清單（SOP 關鍵步驟）：
blocks.en: Method 1 checklist (key SOP steps):

blocks.zh: 開機 ≥ 30 分鐘（冷卻浴平衡至工作溫度）
blocks.en: Power on for ≥ 30 minutes (cooling bath equilibrated to working temperature)

blocks.zh: 確認校正「夾住」預期滲透量（如預期 290，則需 200 和 400 兩個校正點）
blocks.en: Confirm that the calibration "brackets" the expected osmolality (for example, for an expected 290, two calibration points of 200 and 400 are needed)

blocks.zh: 每日使用前執行校正確認
blocks.en: Perform the calibration check before each day of use

blocks.zh: 每次測量前：測量池用待測液沖洗，確認熱電偶清潔乾燥
blocks.en: Before each measurement: rinse the measuring cell with the test solution and confirm the thermocouple is clean and dry

blocks.zh: 執行測量，讀取數據
blocks.en: Perform the measurement and read the data

blocks.zh: 沖洗步驟的邏輯：消除前一個樣品的殘留，確保當前樣品的基質一致性。
blocks.en: The logic of the rinse step: it removes carryover from the previous sample and ensures matrix consistency for the current sample.

blocks.zh: 「稀釋不可乘以稀釋因子」就像問「一杯濃縮咖啡加水稀釋後，咖啡因含量可以直接乘以2嗎？」——不行，因為稀釋後的分子行為（如咖啡因與水的相互作用、溶液密度）都已改變。滲透量也是如此，它不是一個可以線性外推的理想稀釋量。
blocks.en: "Do not multiply by the dilution factor" is like asking "If I dilute a cup of espresso with water, can I just multiply the caffeine content by 2?" No, because the molecular behavior after dilution (such as the interaction of caffeine with water, and the solution density) has changed. The same is true of osmolality: it is not an ideal dilution quantity that can be extrapolated linearly.

blocks.zh: 一個樣品的 osmolality 預期約為 800 mOsmol/kg，超出了你的儀器量程（最大 600 mOsmol/kg），你稀釋一倍後測得 380 mOsmol/kg。請問正確的報告方式是什麼？原始樣品的 osmolality 是多少？
blocks.en: A sample has an expected osmolality of about 800 mOsmol/kg, beyond the range of your instrument (maximum 600 mOsmol/kg). You dilute it 1:1 and measure 380 mOsmol/kg. What is the correct way to report this? What is the osmolality of the original sample?

blocks.zh: 為何測量前要用待測液沖洗測量池，而不能只用純水沖洗？
blocks.en: Why must the measuring cell be rinsed with the test solution before measurement, rather than with purified water only?

blocks.zh: 含乳化液（emulsion）的注射劑在凍結點測量中需要離心去除乳化相。去除後報告的是什麼相的 osmolality？這在臨床上代表什麼意義？
blocks.en: An injection containing an emulsion must be centrifuged to remove the emulsion phase for the freezing-point measurement. Which phase's osmolality is reported after removal? What does this mean clinically?

blocks.en: Troubleshooting Guide

blocks.en: Common causes of freezing failure and countermeasures:

blocks.zh: Method 2: Vapor Pressure Osmometry 蒸氣壓法程序
blocks.en: Method 2: Vapor Pressure Osmometry

blocks.zh: 蒸氣壓法用凍結點法的標準液——為何可行？
blocks.en: The vapor pressure method uses freezing-point standards. Why is this acceptable?

blocks.zh: 這是 USP 的實用性妥協。理論上，蒸氣壓法在室溫測量，應使用室溫下驗證過 osmolality 的標準液。但實際上：
blocks.en: This is a practical compromise in USP. In theory, since the vapor pressure method measures at room temperature, it should use standards whose osmolality has been verified at room temperature. In practice:

blocks.zh: 廠商已將儀器設計為用凍結點法標準液校正
blocks.en: Manufacturers have designed the instruments to be calibrated with freezing-point standards

blocks.zh: 對大多數水性非揮發性溶液，兩種溫度下的 osmolality 差異在儀器誤差範圍內
blocks.en: For most aqueous non-volatile solutions, the difference in osmolality between the two temperatures is within instrument error

blocks.zh: 實務上統一標準液供應，降低了實驗室管理複雜度
blocks.en: In practice, a single standard supply reduces the complexity of laboratory management

blocks.zh: 但這個「可行」是有條件的，不適用於含揮發性溶質或溶質解離常數對溫度高度敏感的樣品。
blocks.en: But this "acceptability" is conditional and does not apply to samples containing volatile solutes or solutes whose dissociation constants are highly temperature sensitive.

blocks.zh: Consistent timing 一致性的重要性：蒸氣壓法測量時，樣品在密封腔體中的蒸發量隨時間增加。若校正時加樣後等待 20 秒再讀數，測試樣品也必須等待 20 秒——否則測到的是不同揮發程度下的露點，無法直接比對。這是蒸氣壓法常見但容易忽略的操作一致性要求。
blocks.en: The importance of consistent timing: in vapor pressure measurement, the amount of sample evaporated in the sealed chamber increases with time. If you wait 20 seconds after sample application before reading during calibration, the test sample must also wait 20 seconds; otherwise you measure dew points at different degrees of evaporation, which cannot be compared directly. This is a common but easily overlooked operational consistency requirement of the vapor pressure method.

blocks.zh: 樣品溫度平衡：冷藏保存的樣品必須回溫至室溫後才能測量。未平衡的樣品會讓密封腔體內的溫度分布不均，直接影響露點測量結果。
blocks.en: Sample temperature equilibration: refrigerated samples must be brought back to room temperature before measurement. An unequilibrated sample causes an uneven temperature distribution in the sealed chamber, which directly affects the dew-point result.

blocks.zh: 蒸氣壓法的「一致計時」就像咖啡師每次萃取濃縮咖啡都用碼表計時——不是因為機器不夠好，而是因為接觸時間直接影響結果。校正和測試必須用完全相同的步驟和時間，才能確保比較有意義。
blocks.en: The "consistent timing" of the vapor pressure method is like a barista timing every espresso extraction with a stopwatch: not because the machine is not good enough, but because contact time directly affects the result. Calibration and testing must use exactly the same steps and times for the comparison to be meaningful.

blocks.zh: 為何蒸氣壓法的儀器需要開機 ≥ 30 分鐘才能測量，而且不只是儀器，連樣品也需要平衡至室溫？請從物理原理解釋。
blocks.en: Why does the vapor pressure instrument need to be powered on for ≥ 30 minutes before measurement, and why must not only the instrument but also the sample be equilibrated to room temperature? Explain from the physical principle.

blocks.zh: 若用蒸氣壓法測量含 10% 乙醇的注射液，結果會偏高還是偏低？請解釋方向。
blocks.en: If an injection containing 10% ethanol is measured by the vapor pressure method, will the result be too high or too low? Explain the direction.

blocks.zh: 校正用 NaCl 標準液的 osmolality 值是在凍結點（約 0°C）的條件下計算的。用蒸氣壓法（室溫 25°C）用相同標準液校正，從理論上來說有何潛在誤差？
blocks.en: The osmolality values of the NaCl calibration standards are calculated at the freezing point (about 0°C). In theory, what potential error arises when the same standards are used to calibrate the vapor pressure method (room temperature, 25°C)?

blocks.zh: Reporting of Results 結果報告
blocks.en: Reporting of Results

blocks.zh: 為何報告平均值而非單次值？
blocks.en: Why report the mean rather than a single value?

blocks.zh: 滲透量計每次測量有隨機誤差（儀器聲稱 repeatability 通常為 ±1–3 mOsmol/kg）。單次測量結果不確定度大；三次平均可將不確定度縮小約 √3 ≈ 1.73 倍。對於規格窗口窄的產品（如 280–320 mOsmol/kg，窗口只有 40 mOsmol/kg），三次平均是確保報告結果可靠的基本要求。
blocks.en: Each osmometer measurement has random error (the claimed instrument repeatability is usually ±1–3 mOsmol/kg). The uncertainty of a single measurement is large; averaging three measurements reduces the uncertainty by a factor of about √3 ≈ 1.73. For products with a narrow specification window (such as 280–320 mOsmol/kg, a window of only 40 mOsmol/kg), the average of three measurements is the basic requirement for a reliable reported result.

blocks.zh: 單位嚴格性："Osmol" 單獨使用時語意不明，必須指定 /kg（osmolality）或 /L（osmolarity）。這在 CMC 文件和標籤上是法規合規的基本要求。
blocks.en: Strict use of units: "Osmol" on its own is ambiguous; /kg (osmolality) or /L (osmolarity) must be specified. This is a basic regulatory compliance requirement in CMC documents and on labels.

blocks.zh: Osmolality → Osmolarity 換算公式
blocks.en: Osmolality → Osmolarity Conversion Formula

blocks.zh:
公式: ξc = ξm × (ρ − C)

說明:
  ξm = 測量的 osmolality (mOsmol/kg)
  ρ  = 溶液密度 (g/mL = kg/L)
  C  = 總溶質濃度 (g/mL)
  (ρ−C) = 每升溶液中水的質量 (kg water/L solution)

範例計算 — 3% NaHCO₃ 溶液:
  ξm  = 615 mOsmol/kg
  ρ   = 1.0192 g/mL
  C   = 0.030 g/mL
  (ρ−C) = 1.0192 − 0.030 = 0.9892 kg/L
  ξc  = 615 × 0.9892 = 608 mOsmol/L

結論: osmolarity 略低於 osmolality
（因為含溶質的溶液，1 L 溶液中的水略少於 1 kg）

補充公式（另一種等效表達）:
  ξc = 1000 × ξm / (1000/ρ + Σ wi × νi)
  其中 νi = 溶質i的偏比容 (mL/g)
  鹽類 νi ≈ 0.1 mL/g; 胺基酸 νi ≈ 0.6–0.9 mL/g
blocks.en:
Formula: ξc = ξm × (ρ − C)

Where:
  ξm = measured osmolality (mOsmol/kg)
  ρ  = solution density (g/mL = kg/L)
  C  = total solute concentration (g/mL)
  (ρ−C) = mass of water per liter of solution (kg water/L solution)

Worked example — 3% NaHCO₃ solution:
  ξm  = 615 mOsmol/kg
  ρ   = 1.0192 g/mL
  C   = 0.030 g/mL
  (ρ−C) = 1.0192 − 0.030 = 0.9892 kg/L
  ξc  = 615 × 0.9892 = 608 mOsmol/L

Conclusion: osmolarity is slightly lower than osmolality
(because in a solution containing solute, 1 L of solution contains slightly less than 1 kg of water)

Additional formula (an equivalent alternative expression):
  ξc = 1000 × ξm / (1000/ρ + Σ wi × νi)
  where νi = partial specific volume of solute i (mL/g)
  Salts νi ≈ 0.1 mL/g; amino acids νi ≈ 0.6–0.9 mL/g

blocks.zh: Osmolarity 永遠略低於 osmolality（對水性溶液而言）：因為含溶質的溶液，1 公升溶液中的水少於 1 公斤（被溶質佔去了一部分體積）。差距通常只有 0.5–3%，對於低滲透量溶液影響不大，但對高滲透量（>1000 mOsmol/kg）的溶液差距較明顯。
blocks.en: Osmolarity is always slightly lower than osmolality (for aqueous solutions): in a solution containing solute, 1 liter of solution contains less than 1 kilogram of water (part of the volume is taken up by the solute). The difference is usually only 0.5–3%, which matters little for solutions of low osmolality but is more noticeable for solutions of high osmolality (>1000 mOsmol/kg).

blocks.zh: 換算需要密度測量：必須實際測量溶液密度，不能使用純水密度代替。注射劑中的輔料（甘露醇、氯化鈉等）會顯著改變溶液密度。
blocks.en: The conversion requires a density measurement: the solution density must actually be measured; the density of pure water cannot be used instead. Excipients in injectables (mannitol, sodium chloride and so on) change the solution density significantly.

blocks.zh: 三次測量結果分別為 288、291、290 mOsmol/kg，請計算平均值（取整數）和標準差，並評估是否需要報告 SD。
blocks.en: Three measurements give 288, 291 and 290 mOsmol/kg. Calculate the mean (rounded to a whole number) and the standard deviation, and assess whether the SD needs to be reported.

blocks.zh: 一個 0.9% NaCl 溶液（密度 1.0046 g/mL，C = 0.009 g/mL），已知其 osmolality = 285 mOsmol/kg，請計算其 osmolarity。
blocks.en: A 0.9% NaCl solution (density 1.0046 g/mL, C = 0.009 g/mL) has a known osmolality of 285 mOsmol/kg. Calculate its osmolarity.

blocks.zh: 為何 USP 禁止單獨使用 "Osmol" 而不加 /kg 或 /L？在臨床醫囑或藥品標籤上，這個區別有多重要？
blocks.en: Why does USP prohibit using "Osmol" alone without /kg or /L? How important is this distinction on clinical orders or drug product labels?

blocks.zh: Tonicity 張力
blocks.en: Tonicity

blocks.zh: Tonicity vs. Osmolality — 為何不同？
blocks.en: Tonicity vs. Osmolality: why do they differ?

blocks.zh: 關鍵在於溶質是否能穿越細胞膜：
blocks.en: The key is whether the solute can cross the cell membrane:

blocks.zh: 不能穿越（如 NaCl、甘露醇）：完全貢獻 tonicity → osmolality ≈ tonicity effect
blocks.en: Cannot cross (such as NaCl, mannitol): contributes fully to tonicity → osmolality ≈ tonicity effect

blocks.zh: 能快速穿越（如尿素、乙醇、乙二醇）：不影響 tonicity → 高滲透量但不導致細胞脫水
blocks.en: Crosses rapidly (such as urea, ethanol, ethylene glycol): does not affect tonicity → high osmolality but does not cause cell dehydration

blocks.zh: 例：一個含高濃度尿素的溶液，osmolality 可能是 400 mOsmol/kg（高滲），但對紅血球而言是「等張」的，因為尿素可自由穿越細胞膜，不會造成滲透壓差。
blocks.en: Example: a solution containing a high concentration of urea may have an osmolality of 400 mOsmol/kg (hyperosmotic), but it is "isotonic" to red blood cells, because urea crosses the cell membrane freely and does not create an osmotic pressure difference.

blocks.zh: 術語對照：
blocks.en: Terminology comparison:

blocks.zh: Hypoosmotic（低滲透量）≈ 對NaCl等有效溶質而言的 hypotonic
blocks.en: Hypoosmotic ≈ hypotonic with respect to effective solutes such as NaCl

blocks.zh: Hyperosmotic（高滲透量）≈ 對NaCl等有效溶質而言的 hypertonic
blocks.en: Hyperosmotic ≈ hypertonic with respect to effective solutes such as NaCl

blocks.zh: Isoosmotic（等滲透量）= osmolality 接近 285–310 mOsmol/kg
blocks.en: Isoosmotic = osmolality close to 285–310 mOsmol/kg

blocks.zh: 把細胞膜想像成一扇門：有些溶質是「有鑰匙的」（能自由進出，如尿素），有些是「沒有鑰匙的」（被擋在門外，如 NaCl）。只有被擋在門外的溶質才真正產生滲透壓差（tonicity 效果）。測量 osmolality 是量「門外所有人」的總數，而 tonicity 只量「沒有鑰匙、真的被擋住」的那部分人。所以 osmolality 是 tonicity 的上限，實際 tonicity 通常更低。
blocks.en: Picture the cell membrane as a door: some solutes "have a key" (they can move in and out freely, such as urea) and some "have no key" (they are kept outside the door, such as NaCl). Only the solutes kept outside the door actually create an osmotic pressure difference (the tonicity effect). Measuring osmolality counts "everyone outside the door", whereas tonicity counts only the people who "have no key and are really kept out". So osmolality is the upper limit of tonicity, and the actual tonicity is usually lower.

blocks.zh: 臨床重要性：注射劑標籤上標示的「等張」（isotonic）是基於 tonicity（對細胞膜有效溶質），而非單純 osmolality。將「等張」等同於 285 mOsmol/kg 是常見的簡化，在大多數情況下成立，但含高濃度通透性溶質（如甘油、尿素）的製劑需要特別說明。
blocks.en: Clinical importance: the "isotonic" stated on an injectable label is based on tonicity (solutes that are effective across the cell membrane), not simply on osmolality. Equating "isotonic" with 285 mOsmol/kg is a common simplification that holds in most cases, but formulations containing high concentrations of permeable solutes (such as glycerol and urea) need special explanation.

blocks.zh: 0.9% NaCl 的標準地位：285 mOsmol/kg（osmolality）/ 284 mOsmol/L（osmolarity）是業界公認的等滲參考點。這也是為何注射劑通常以此為設計目標。
blocks.en: The standard status of 0.9% NaCl: 285 mOsmol/kg (osmolality) / 284 mOsmol/L (osmolarity) is the industry-accepted isotonic reference point. This is why injectables are usually designed to this target.

blocks.zh: 一個含 5% 甘油（glycerol，能自由穿越細胞膜）和 0.45% NaCl 的注射液，其 osmolality 大約是多少？它對紅血球的 tonicity 效果相當於哪種程度的 NaCl 溶液？
blocks.en: An injection containing 5% glycerol (which crosses the cell membrane freely) and 0.45% NaCl: what is its approximate osmolality? What level of NaCl solution is its tonicity effect on red blood cells equivalent to?

blocks.zh: 為何 USP 建議使用「hypoosmotic/hyperosmotic/isoosmotic」而非「hypotonic/hypertonic/isotonic」來描述溶液的滲透量特性？
blocks.en: Why does USP recommend using "hypoosmotic/hyperosmotic/isoosmotic" rather than "hypotonic/hypertonic/isotonic" to describe the osmolality characteristics of a solution?

blocks.zh: 在製藥 CMC 文件中，如果你需要聲明一個注射劑是「等張」的，應測量的是 tonicity 還是 osmolality？這兩個測試目前在實驗室中哪個更容易操作？
blocks.en: In a pharmaceutical CMC document, if you need to declare an injectable "isotonic", should you measure tonicity or osmolality? Which of the two tests is currently easier to perform in the laboratory?

blocks.zh: Osmolarity — Calculated vs. Measured 滲透濃度：計算值與測量值
blocks.en: Osmolarity — Calculated vs. Measured

blocks.zh: 「計算的 osmolarity」永遠只是估算！
blocks.en: "Calculated osmolarity" is only ever an estimate!

blocks.zh: Vancomycin 案例是教科書級的示範：計算值（329 mOsmol/L）比實測值（255 mOsmol/kg）高出 29%。原因包括：
blocks.en: The vancomycin case is a textbook demonstration: the calculated value (329 mOsmol/L) is 29% higher than the measured value (255 mOsmol/kg). The reasons include:

blocks.zh: Vancomycin 是大分子糖肽，在水中有強的自締合（self-association）傾向，有效溶質粒子數遠少於理論值
blocks.en: Vancomycin is a large glycopeptide molecule with a strong tendency to self-associate in water, so the number of effective solute particles is far lower than the theoretical value

blocks.zh: 計算用 ν = 3（一個分子解離成 3 個粒子），但實際上不完全解離
blocks.en: The calculation used ν = 3 (one molecule dissociating into 3 particles), but in reality dissociation is incomplete

blocks.zh: Φ<sub>m</sub> << 1，大幅降低了有效滲透壓
blocks.en: Φ<sub>m</sub> << 1, which greatly reduces the effective osmotic pressure

blocks.zh: 這就是為何 USP 〈785〉 強調：「osmolarity values calculated theoretically should be interpreted cautiously」，以及為何現行版本的章節架構把「測量 osmolality」擺在核心位置。
blocks.en: This is why USP <785> emphasizes: "osmolarity values calculated theoretically should be interpreted cautiously", and why the current version places "measurement of osmolality" at the core of the chapter structure.

blocks.zh:
理論計算公式（適用於理想溶液）:
  ξc,theoretical = Σ (νi × ci)
  νi = 解離係數（離子數）
  ci = 各溶質莫耳濃度

Vancomycin 案例:
  Vanco 10 g/L ÷ 1449.25 g/mol × 3 = 20.7 mOsmol/L
  NaCl  9 g/L ÷ 58.44 g/mol × 2 = 308.0 mOsmol/L
  計算總計 = 329 mOsmol/L
  實測滲透量 = 255 mOsmol/kg
  差異 = -23%（計算值高估了 osmolality）

結論: 含大分子或有自締合的溶質時，
      計算值誤差可達 20–50%，必須實驗測定！
blocks.en:
Theoretical calculation formula (for ideal solutions):
  ξc,theoretical = Σ (νi × ci)
  νi = dissociation factor (number of ions)
  ci = molar concentration of each solute

Vancomycin case:
  Vanco 10 g/L ÷ 1449.25 g/mol × 3 = 20.7 mOsmol/L
  NaCl  9 g/L ÷ 58.44 g/mol × 2 = 308.0 mOsmol/L
  Calculated total = 329 mOsmol/L
  Measured osmolality = 255 mOsmol/kg
  Difference = -23% (the calculated value overestimates osmolality)

Conclusion: for solutes that are large molecules or self-associate,
      the error in the calculated value can reach 20–50%, so it must be determined experimentally!

blocks.zh: 現行 USP 〈785〉 版本（2020年以來）已刪除舊版 "OSMOLARITY" 和 "MEASUREMENT OF OSMOLALITY" 獨立章節，將所有內容整合重組。這個版本更新反映了：
blocks.en: The current USP <785> (since 2020) has deleted the separate former "OSMOLARITY" and "MEASUREMENT OF OSMOLALITY" sections and integrated and reorganized all the content. This revision reflects that:

blocks.zh: 理論計算 osmolarity 不可靠，不應作為製藥測試的替代方案
blocks.en: Theoretically calculated osmolarity is unreliable and should not be used as a substitute for pharmaceutical testing

blocks.zh: 所有 osmolality/osmolarity 結果應以實驗測定為基礎
blocks.en: All osmolality/osmolarity results should be based on experimental determination

blocks.zh: 換算公式 ξ<sub>c</sub> = ξ<sub>m</sub> × (ρ−C) 才是正確的 osmolarity 計算方式
blocks.en: The conversion formula ξ<sub>c</sub> = ξ<sub>m</sub> × (ρ−C) is the correct way to calculate osmolarity

blocks.zh: 理論計算 osmolarity 就像只看食譜上的材料清單估算一道菜的鹹度——理論上你知道放了多少鹽，但鹽分在烹飪過程中與其他食材的交互作用是無法預測的。實際嘗味（實驗測定）才是唯一可靠的方式。Vancomycin 案例就是一個「理論上很鹹，實際上不鹹」的典型例子。
blocks.en: Theoretically calculating osmolarity is like estimating how salty a dish is just from the ingredient list in the recipe: in theory you know how much salt went in, but how the salt interacts with the other ingredients during cooking cannot be predicted. Actually tasting it (experimental determination) is the only reliable way. The vancomycin case is a classic example of something that is "theoretically very salty but not actually salty".

blocks.zh: Vancomycin 案例中，實測 osmolality（255 mOsmol/kg）遠低於計算 osmolarity（329 mOsmol/L）。請說明哪些物理化學機制可以解釋這個差異。
blocks.en: In the vancomycin case, the measured osmolality (255 mOsmol/kg) is far lower than the calculated osmolarity (329 mOsmol/L). Explain which physicochemical mechanisms can account for this difference.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的製劑開發中，什麼時候可以用理論計算的 osmolarity 作為參考，什麼時候必須實驗測定？
blocks.en: In CDMO formulation development, when can theoretically calculated osmolarity be used as a reference, and when must it be determined experimentally?

blocks.zh: 現行 USP 〈785〉 為何要刪除「OSMOLARITY」和「MEASUREMENT OF OSMOLALITY」獨立章節並整合重寫？這個修訂傳達了什麼科學訊息？
blocks.en: Why did the current USP <785> delete the separate "OSMOLARITY" and "MEASUREMENT OF OSMOLALITY" sections and integrate and rewrite them? What scientific message does this revision convey?

blocks.zh: References 參考文獻
blocks.en: References

blocks.zh: 核心參考文獻解析
blocks.en: Key References Explained

blocks.zh: References 8 & 9（Scatchard 1933, Gibbard 1974）：這是 USP Table 1 NaCl 校正液配方的實驗數據基礎。100年前（Scatchard）和50年前（Gibbard）的精確凍結點下降測量數據，至今仍是 USP 的計算依據——足見高品質基礎科學數據的持久價值。
blocks.en: References 8 & 9 (Scatchard 1933, Gibbard 1974): these are the experimental data basis for the USP Table 1 NaCl calibration solution formulations. Accurate freezing-point depression data from 100 years ago (Scatchard) and 50 years ago (Gibbard) are still the basis of USP calculations today, which shows the lasting value of high-quality basic scientific data.

blocks.zh: Reference 1（Pitzer 1984）：Pitzer–Debye–Hückel 方程的原始來源，支撐了 NaCl 校正液的理論計算框架（β₀, β₁, C⁰ 參數的實驗擬合）。
blocks.en: Reference 1 (Pitzer 1984): the original source of the Pitzer–Debye–Hückel equation, which underpins the theoretical calculation framework for NaCl calibration solutions (experimental fitting of the β₀, β₁, C⁰ parameters).

blocks.zh: Reference 10（NIST traceable solutions）：NIST（美國國家標準與技術研究院）可追溯性是 GMP 環境中校正液的最高品質標準，確保量測的國際可比性。
blocks.en: Reference 10 (NIST traceable solutions): NIST (the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology) traceability is the highest quality standard for calibration solutions in a GMP environment, ensuring international comparability of measurements.

blocks.zh: NIST 可追溯性對製藥 GMP 環境至關重要。使用市售校正安瓿時，其憑證必須聲明可追溯至 NIST（或等效國際標準機構）。這是 FDA 483 和 Warning Letter 中常見的稽查要點——若無法提供可追溯性文件，整個滲透量測量系統的可信度都受到質疑。
blocks.en: NIST traceability is essential in a pharmaceutical GMP environment. When commercial calibration ampoules are used, their certificate must state traceability to NIST (or an equivalent international standards body). This is a common inspection point in FDA 483s and Warning Letters: if traceability documentation cannot be provided, the credibility of the entire osmolality measurement system is called into question.

blocks.zh: Advanced Instruments（USP 提及的供應商）是製藥業最廣泛使用的滲透量計品牌之一，其校正安瓿是業界標準品。但 USP 也明確指出「其他符合 NIST 可追溯性的供應商亦可使用」——給了廠家靈活性。
blocks.en: Advanced Instruments (the supplier mentioned by USP) is one of the most widely used osmometer brands in the pharmaceutical industry, and its calibration ampoules are an industry standard. But USP also states explicitly that "other suppliers with NIST traceability may also be used", which gives manufacturers flexibility.

blocks.zh: Scatchard（1933）的凍結點測量數據跨度達 2–7300 mOsmol/kg。這說明了什麼？為何需要這麼寬的範圍？
blocks.en: Scatchard's (1933) freezing-point data span 2–7300 mOsmol/kg. What does this show? Why is such a wide range needed?

blocks.zh: 市售 NIST 可追溯性校正液的憑證（COA）中，應包含哪些關鍵信息才能滿足 GMP 要求？
blocks.en: What key information should the certificate (COA) of a commercial NIST-traceable calibration solution contain to meet GMP requirements?

blocks.zh: 若你的 CDMO 採購了一批校正液，但找不到 NIST 可追溯性聲明，你應該如何處理？
blocks.en: If your CDMO has purchased a batch of calibration solution but cannot find a NIST traceability statement, how should you handle it?

blocks.zh: USP 〈785〉 全章重點整合表 Comprehensive Summary
blocks.en: Comprehensive Summary Table of USP <785>

blocks.zh: 全章最終重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 校正必須「夾住」（bracket）預期測量範圍，每日使用前確認；確認失敗需重新校正後再次確認，並評估期間所有已測樣品
blocks.en: Calibration must "bracket" the expected measurement range, with a check before each day of use; if the check fails, recalibrate and check again, and assess all samples measured in the interim

blocks.zh: 固體注射劑按標籤指示重配；樣品稀釋後結果只代表稀釋液，不可外推至原始濃度（Φ<sub>m</sub> 非線性）
blocks.en: Solid injections are reconstituted according to the label instructions; after dilution, the result represents only the diluted solution and must not be extrapolated to the original concentration (Φ<sub>m</sub> is nonlinear)

blocks.zh: 高黏度樣品可能需要優化 buzz 參數；不溶性相干擾凍結時應離心後測澄清液相
blocks.en: High-viscosity samples may need optimized buzz parameters; when insoluble phases interfere with freezing, centrifuge and measure the clear liquid phase

blocks.zh: Osmolarity 換算必須基於測量的 osmolality，搭配溶液密度和溶質濃度的實測值（公式：ξ<sub>c</sub> = ξ<sub>m</sub> × (ρ−C)）
blocks.en: The osmolarity conversion must be based on the measured osmolality, together with measured values of solution density and solute concentration (formula: ξ<sub>c</sub> = ξ<sub>m</sub> × (ρ−C))

blocks.zh: Tonicity ≠ Osmolality——能穿越細胞膜的溶質（尿素、乙醇等）不貢獻 tonicity；0.9% NaCl（285 mOsmol/kg）是等滲參考標準
blocks.en: Tonicity ≠ Osmolality: solutes that can cross the cell membrane (urea, ethanol and so on) do not contribute to tonicity; 0.9% NaCl (285 mOsmol/kg) is the isotonic reference standard

blocks.zh: 理論計算 osmolarity 誤差可達 20–50%（Vancomycin 案例）；實驗測定永遠是製藥環境的最終依據
blocks.en: The error in theoretically calculated osmolarity can reach 20–50% (vancomycin case); experimental determination is always the final basis in a pharmaceutical environment
